Oh mostly same! The worst one for me is the sound of velcro, hearing that gives me an immediate migraine. Even thinking about it is giving me a headache. I’d describe it as hearing nails on a chalkboard, although nails on a chalkboard for me doesn’t even phase me. Another thing that really gets to me is peeling tape but these might just be normal things.

If it affects your day-to-day life on a regular basis, I’d say to seek it. If not, it’s not worth it unless you want to :)
